messages:
elaine: Draft SOW and launch checklist uploaded. High level: three packaging tracks (edge connector, VPC-peering, airgap bundle), explicit pre-reqs, acceptance suite, and rollback playbook. Look for gaps.

sam: Thanks. Question: do we promise IP preservation or just document it as an opt-in service?

kyle: We should offer IP preservation as a paid option. That requires preserved-peering mode, allocation windows, and formal rollback steps. NetOps handshake needed. :thumbsup:

mira: Ops checklist proposal: DNS records, BGP creds, cert provisioning, KMS key handoff, cross-account roles. Do we include an airgap installer variant in the baseline SOW?

elaine: Call it out as track 3 (airgap bundle) and list expected lead times. Most customers will take track 2 (VPC-peering).

sam: For on-prem rolling upgrades, what's the downtime SLO? We need rolling upgrades with canaries to avoid leader elections killing inference.

kyle: Target <= 10m visible disruption per tenant if images/configs pre-staged. Airgap patches will be longer and noted in the SOW. We'll record metrics to validate.

mira: Acceptance tests for customer staging: inference smoke, KV cache sanity, TLS cert validation, model pinning verification, throughput within 20% of baseline, latency check.

elaine: Add explicit latency gate: 99th percentile must be within +200ms of baseline for SLA customers. Add automated harness for these tests.

sam: I'll add a CI job and helper: `./tools/deploy-smoke --env customer-xyz --tests basic,kvs,latency` that outputs pass/fail artifacts.

deploy-bot: CI: smoke test job started for env=customer-xyz (#7890). Logs: https://ci.redwood/7890

kyle: Rollback strategy: cache previous runtime images, `--force-rollback` in operator CLI, and network rollback checklist (peering revert, IP reassign). Network rollback requires coordination with customer NetOps.

mira: Field handoff doc should include contact matrix, escalation path (SRE -> NetOps -> CS), demo script for verification, and a customer sign-off checklist for staging.

elaine: Launch gates proposed: (1) SOW signed, (2) preflight cleared, (3) acceptance tests green in staging, (4) runbook + PagerDuty configured, (5) capacity & model pinning validated. Anything else?

sam: Add capacity validation: reserved GPU counts verified, quantization profile applied if used, smoke test under load, and fallback model set confirmed.

kyle: Also require IPAM confirmation: reserved customer IP ranges, NAT/egress plan, and transit/NVA requirements documented.

mira: I'll draft the customer checklist and a handoff email template to NetOps/CS. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

elaine: Action items: Sam -> CI smoke job + runbook; Kyle -> peering and rollback steps; Mira -> customer checklist + email; Elaine -> finalize SOW. Sync tomorrow 11:00am PT. :calendar: 

sam: ack

kyle: ack

mira: on it
